title: Satin density 0.3 lines/mm on a 40 × 6 mm column
description: A 40 × 6 mm rectangle sewn as satin across the 6 mm (Direction 90°), under sewing off, density 0.3 (lines 3.3 mm apart): near PE-DESIGN's minimum the crossings are joined by diagonals whose period follows the density; stitch count and extent as in PE-DESIGN's file.

featureMatrix.feature: Satin: a zigzag across the column

evidence.note: Fill Stitch and Satin Stitch: Density, Pull compensation, Under sewing, Direction, Step pitch, Gradation
PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference stitches/sweep-satin-density-0p3.pes (pe-refs-3 minimum-density sweep, 2026-10-28): 47 stitches

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page (grid 1 mm, Snap to Grid) draw a 40 × 6 mm rectangle with the Rectangle tool from (10, 10) to (50, 16) mm. Line Not Sewn; colour 800 RED; region sew type Satin Stitch, Direction Manual straight line 90°, Under sewing unticked, Density 0.3, Pull compensation 0.0 mm, Half Stitch at its default, every other attribute at PE-DESIGN's default. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).
